AICB-Benchmark-Vik
	

AICB - Analog Integrated Circuit Benchmark. Contains 520 QA samples: 300 test samples and 220 difficult samples. Each sample includes Question, Options A-D, Correct Answer, and Domain.

	
		
		Dataset Description
	

This dataset was processed using the data-preproc package for vision-language model training.

Base Model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct
